name: pantheon-barrier-printed-omnishroud-spell-cannot-target-it
notes: Pantheon Barrier: printed Omnishroud -- an opposing spell cannot target it. Pantheon Barrier (WyNvyDHFdB, TOKEN,PHANTASIA,DOMAIN): "Omnishroud". Omnishroud means "This can't be targeted by activations, materializations, or triggered abilities" (comprehensive rules, Keywords > Omnishroud 1); a spell is a card activation, so an Omnishroud object can't be targeted by spells -- Spellshroud and Omnishroud are redundant with each other (Omnishroud 3a). The engine already applied that to the OMNISHROUD turn effect and Argus, All-Seeing Giant, but printed Omnishroud on these cards was never recognised: HasSpellshroud() only knew a hard-coded card-ID list. Player 2 controls the holder plus a Ominous Shadow; player 1 plays Disenchant ("Destroy target phantasia", a Spell): the target prompt offers ONLY the Ominous Shadow, answering with the holder is refused (expectFailure) and the legal answer then resolves.

rulesClauses: Omnishroud: this can't be targeted by activations, materializations, or triggered abilities (so not by spells).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Pantheon Barrier's printed Omnishroud was not implemented: a spell could target it. HasSpellshroud() (Custom/GameLogic.php) recognised printed Spellshroud only through a hard-coded card-ID list and HasKeyword_Spellshroud(), which is never generated (Data/ProcessKeywordsGA.php has no Spellshroud keyword, so function_exists is false), and WyNvyDHFdB was in neither. Evidence on HEAD 48faaae9 (this fixture, run against the unfixed Custom/GameLogic.php): player 1's spell target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-1&theirField-2' -- every holder was offered, and the first refused answer was accepted ('Step 4 unexpectedly succeeded'). Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for the printed-Omnishroud card IDs (a spell is an activation, which Omnishroud forbids targeting) after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasSpellshroud() (no entry for WyNvyDHFdB; no generated HasKeyword_Spellshroud table)
